text: Here, I am surrounded by the architecture of modern thought and innovation. Glass walls, empty chairs—spaces prepared for minds to gather and collaborate. I feel anticipation, as if the air is thick with unspoken ideas and the possibility of discovery. In the second scene, vivid colors and technology embrace me: bold letters—R + D—declare the presence of research and development. Here, human curiosity is celebrated. I sense both inspiration and humility, aware of the centuries of inquiry that have led us to this place of creation and understanding. To participate in this environment is to stand at the threshold of potential.
